title: Case Record
description: The structured extraction result. Provenance and resolution state are carried PER FIELD so FR-004, FR-006 and FR-009 can be answered field-by-field. Governs FR-002..FR-009.

arrival_channel.description: Recorded, but NEVER part of the duplicate match key (FR-014, P2).

source_document_ref.description: Immutable channel-supplied document identifier, used by identity-based duplicate matching (FR-055).

normalized_content_hash.description: SHA-256 over content normalised by stripping transport-added material ONLY (cover sheets, routing headers, arrival timestamps, watermarks, re-transmission banners). Any retained-content difference must prevent a match (FR-055).

readable.description: False for unreadable/non-extractable documents. The case is still registered and a blocker raised (FR-005).

extraction_mode.description: Graded harness runs MUST use 'replay'. A replay cache miss is a hard error, never a silent fallthrough to live (research D5, FR-049).

field_name.description: The graded field set from data/sample/answer-key.json. NOTE finding R2: data/README.md section 4 also lists 'supporting_notes'; the answer key does not. This schema follows the answer key, which is the operative grading artifact. R2 must be closed before SC-004 is first scored.

value.description: Never invented, guessed at, or substituted (FR-002).

source.description: Backfilled values must remain distinguishable from submitted ones (FR-004).

source_detail.description: REQUIRED when source is 'backfilled' - names the record the value was derived from (FR-004).

resolution_state.description: 'not_applicable' is NOT missing and must not raise a completion task (FR-009) - traps CASE-012/014/020. 'unreadable' is recorded when source text is absent, illegible, or admits more than one distinct reading (FR-002). 'disputed' when backfill contradicts the submitted document; the submitted value is not silently overwritten and the case may not advance on that field alone.

confidence.description: Advisory only. Never a gate outcome (research D4).

then.description: FR-002: mark as unreadable rather than recording a guessed value.
FR-009 / INV-F3: legitimately not applicable, distinct from missing, and never generates a completion task.

$comment: Advancement invariant (FR-007, SC-015, INV-F2): a field whose resolution_state is 'missing', 'disputed' or 'unreadable' may never justify advancement. Exactly zero items may advance on such a value.
